findings.description: Only the empty-a-water-bucket-on-a-block route is exercised. Two other routes guarded under the same ability have no rows: scooping water and catching a mob with a water bucket.

The probe reports the tested ability as null ("USE_WATER_BUCKET": null) in every state line, so the server log never shows the lock state of this ability. Locked status follows only from count < threshold, which I confirmed against the raw config, and from the client overlay in rows.jsonl.

The client-mod path is stored with its Cyrillic folder name mojibake-encoded (UTF-8 bytes read as cp1251), so a third party cannot open it as written. I located the real file and its hash matches. This is a record defect only.
